# MCL 206.520 Subsection (1) - Homestead Property Tax Credit

**Refund Provision:**
"If the credit claimed under this section and section 522 exceeds the tax liability for the tax year or if there is no tax liability for the tax year, the amount of the claim not used as an offset against the tax liability shall, after examination and review, be approved for payment, without interest, to the claimant."

This language appears in subsection (3), not subsection (1). Subsection (1) establishes the basic credit for property taxes on a homestead.

**Subsidized Housing Reference:**
Subsection (2) addresses rent-subsidized housing, stating that persons renting under the state housing development authority program "may claim a similar credit computed under this section and section 522 based upon 10% of the gross rent paid."

Subsection (4) also permits senior citizens in federally or state-aided housing to assign their tax credit payment to a mortgagor if the mortgagor reduces the claimant's rent accordingly.
